map.编辑距离和余弦相似度怎么选？: How Do I Choose Between Edit Distance and Cosine Similarity?
map.编辑距离衡量「改成一样要多少步」，适合拼写纠错、短文本与近似匹配；余弦相似度衡量: Edit distance measures how many steps are needed to make two strings identical, which suits spell correction, short text, and fuzzy matching. Cosine similarity measures how close the bag-of-words distributions are, which suits long text and topic comparison, but it ignores word order and Chinese needs tokenization first. Real systems often combine both: coarse-filter by similarity, then rank precisely with edit distance.
